channel.title: Yusin Kim
channel.description: Measurements and notes on AI agents, tooling, and research workflow, written by a physician-researcher.

item.title: anydoc: 어떤 문서든 넣으면 마크다운 — 한국어 문서를 넣어봤다
item.description: Firecrawl의 anydoc을 한국어 의료 문서로 고문 테스트했다. 무엇이 살아남고, 무엇이 깨지고, 왜 한국어 PDF가 최악의 케이스인가.

item.title: anydoc says any document in, Markdown out. I fed it Korean documents.
item.description: An agent-run torture test of Firecrawl's anydoc against Korean medical documents: what survives, what breaks, and why Korean PDFs are the worst case for every extractor.

item.title: I set the wrong question for the model
item.description: I asked four setups for the research ideas most likely to be accepted. They converged on the same two, and the reason was in my question, not in the models.
